# NeuralNg Drawer

- Import NeuralDrawer, NeuralDrawerHeader, NeuralDrawerBody,
  NeuralDrawerFooter, and NeuralDrawerInitialFocus from
  @neural-ng/core/drawer. Never generate their deprecated Drawer* aliases.
- Use position="start|end|top|bottom". Start/end are logical and RTL-aware.
- Bind [(open)] or call show(), toggle(), and close().
- Native dialog provides modal top-layer behavior and focus containment without a global overlay container.
- Non-modal mode uses the Popover top layer when available, stays above
  application chrome, and leaves background content interactive.
- Use ariaLabel or ariaLabelledby. Prefer a visible heading referenced by ariaLabelledby.
- closeOnEscape and dismissibleBackdrop default to true. closed reports api, escape, backdrop, close-button, or native.
- neuralDrawerInitialFocus moves initial focus. Focus returns to the opener after close.
- Header, body, and footer section components keep the body independently scrollable.
- unstyled removes visual base classes but retains structural hooks, semantics, placement, and behavior.
- classes provides typed root, header, body, footer, closeButton, and closeIcon slots.
- The default close icon uses Neural Icons nt nt-x.
